text_blocks.snippet: Obesity, a condition characterized by excessive body fat, can manifest through various physical and psychological symptoms. Common physical signs include excess fat, particularly around the waist, back and joint pain, shortness of breath, and fatigue. Psychological effects can include low self-esteem, depression, shame, and social isolation.
